_readme: WHAT WE HAVE PUBLISHED — flyers, the website, printed material.
This file is NOT a price list and nothing quotes from it. uCRM is the only
source of truth for what a customer is told; the AI reads the catalogue live
and this file is never loaded by the plugin at runtime (tests assert that).
Its only job is to be compared against uCRM by tools/price_check.php, so that
the day someone changes a price in uCRM and the flyer still says the old one,
it shows up as a report instead of as an argument with a customer holding the
flyer. Update it when the printed material changes, not when uCRM changes.
'match' is a case-insensitive substring of the uCRM item name. 'published' is
null for anything we deliberately do not publish — Business is quoted on the
day, which is why the flyer says ASK FOR TODAY'S QUOTE.
